name: Marvin Jackson
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with the [Machine], [Cyborg] or [SoC] trait in your hand, gain 1 memory.
[Main] ＜Mind Link＞ to 1 of your Digimon with the [Machine], [Cyborg] or [SoC] trait. (Place this Tamer as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card if there are no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.)
source_effect:
[All Turns] While this Digimon has the [Machine], [Cyborg] or [SoC] trait, it gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[End of All Turns] You may play 1 [Marvin Jackson] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
